run_viewer_server: run a 3D Gaussian Splatting viewer server on a specified host and port with a model root path
run_viewer_with_cameras: run the viewer server with camera frustums visible and reorientation enabled for a 3D scene
run_viewer_with_pca: run the viewer server with PCA visualized features enabled for learned Gaussian features
find_nearest_se3: find the nearest 6D pose from a set of poses to a given reference pose using Frobenius norm
scan_avail_iters: scan a model path directory and return all available training iteration checkpoint names
